title: Why ATC can't see you! (MSFS transponder & squawk code guide)
description:
Dialing four simple numbers on your transponder changes everything on an air traffic controller's radar screen in seconds—and getting it wrong can make you completely invisible to ATC. In this in-depth MSFS tutorial, we break down how transponders actually work, how to decode standard VFR and emergency squawk codes, and how to avoid the most common rookie mistakes in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

If you have ever wondered why ATC says "radar contact lost" even when you dialed the right code, when to press Squawk Ident, what TA/RA actually does on an airliner, or which emergency code will get you immediately disconnected by a VATSIM supervisor, this Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and MSFS 2020 guide covers everything you need to fly with real-world ATC discipline.

⏱️ Chapters:
00:00 The 4-Digit Transponder Mistake (How ATC Sees You)
00:25 VFR Squawk Codes Explained: 1200 (US) vs. 7000 (Europe)
00:40 The Standby Trap: Why VATSIM ATC Says "Radar Contact Lost"
01:02 Mode C / ALT RPTG & When to Press Squawk Ident
01:21 Emergency Squawk Codes (7500, 7600, 7700 Memory Trick)
01:55 Airliner TCAS Modes: TA vs. RA Explained
